entries.en: ...Hey.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What's going on here? You brought over[n]another girl?
Don't get any ideas.
Don't let it worry you.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: That's not what I meant... Anyway, don't[n]break her heart, all right?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Of course it worries me. I'm your[n]guardian.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: So, you found our cat, and even took[n]care of it?

entries.speaker: Haru

entries.en: What's up? You seem happy.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's been a while since I've had a meal[n]with so many people.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Make sure you go home today before it[n]gets too late, okay? I'm sure your parents[n]are worried.

entries.en: No, I'll go home.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If my father suspects something, it'll be[n]more difficult to change his heart,[n]wouldn't it?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'll contact you again so— Oh right!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Can we exchange contact info?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Will you be okay on your own? If you[n]need, I can go with you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You belong here, don't you, Mona-chan?

entries.en: W-Well, yeah...
